title: CipherChat
tagline: Post-quantum end-to-end encrypted chat, voice and video.
dataNote: Messages are encrypted on your devices; your own server only ever stores ciphertext. This PC keeps just its pairing, sealed with Windows.
intro: This sets up CipherChat on this PC: private rooms, direct messages, files and HD voice and video calls with the people on your own CipherChat server. Every message, file, call frame and connection is protected against today's computers and tomorrow's quantum ones. Free and open source.

highlights.title: Post-quantum everywhere
highlights.detail: ML-KEM-1024 + X25519 keys, ML-DSA-87 + Ed25519 signatures, and TLS 1.3 with X25519MLKEM768 only.

highlights.title: Calls end to end
highlights.detail: HD voice and video, every frame encrypted again inside the call; the server and relays see noise.

highlights.title: Trust you can check
highlights.detail: Compare a 60-digit safety number once, then everyone is verified by the owner's signature.

highlights.title: Your server, your rules
highlights.detail: Runs against your own CipherChat server on Linux or Windows; nothing passes through anyone else.

builtBy: Built by DarkCipher0x at DarkCipher Systems
doneNote: Open CipherChat and pair it with a code from the web chat (/pair) or sign in to your server. Help and guides are at darkciphersystems.com.

options.title: Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime
options.detail: Required for voice and video calls.

removeData.title: Also remove this PC's pairings
removeData.detail: The sealed list of servers this PC is paired with, for this Windows user. Your messages stay on your server either way.
